items.name: screen_lock
items.query: SELECT enabled, delay_seconds FROM preferences WHERE domain = 'com.apple.screensaver';

items.name: os_version
items.query: SELECT major, minor, patch, build FROM os_version;

items.name: auto_update_enabled
items.query: SELECT enabled FROM preferences WHERE domain = 'com.apple.SoftwareUpdate';

items.name: edr_running
items.query: SELECT name FROM processes WHERE name IN ('sentinelone', 'crowdstrike', 'falcon-sensor');

items.name: admin_account_count
items.query: SELECT username FROM user_groups WHERE groupname = 'admin';

items.name: password_manager_installed
items.query: SELECT name FROM apps WHERE name IN ('1Password', 'Bitwarden', 'KeePassXC');

items.name: unapproved_apps
items.query: SELECT name FROM apps WHERE name NOT IN ('1Password', 'Bitwarden', 'KeePassXC', 'Google Chrome', 'Safari', 'Microsoft Edge', 'Firefox');

items.name: device_identity
items.query: SELECT serial, model, hostname, os_family FROM system_info;
